question: How many customers placed completed orders in both 2024 and 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status='completed' AND YEAR(order_date) IN (2024,2025) GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT YEAR(order_date))=2) t

question: What is the repeat purchase rate: the percentage of customers with at least 2 completed orders among customers with at least 1 completed order?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100*SUM(n>=2)/COUNT(*),2) FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY customer_id) t

question: For each country, what is net revenue per customer, dividing by ALL customers in that country including those who never bought?
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(cr.rev,0))/COUNT(*),2) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.customer_id) cr ON cr.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

question: Which products have a margin below 40% based on list price and cost, where margin = (price - cost) / price?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE (price-cost)/price < 0.40

question: Show the running total of net revenue by month for 2025.
gold_sql: SELECT ym, ROUND(SUM(rev) OVER (ORDER BY ym),2) FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date,'%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND YEAR(o.order_date)=2025  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date,'%Y-%m')) m

question: What is the average discount percentage by sales channel, weighted by item quantity, for completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.discount_pct*oi.quantity)/SUM(oi.quantity),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.channel

question: For each customer segment, what percentage of its customers are active customers?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(100*COUNT(cr.customer_id)/COUNT(*),2) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.customer_id) cr ON cr.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: How many completed orders have a net value above the average completed order value?
gold_sql: WITH ov AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS v FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.order_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ov WHERE v > (SELECT AVG(v) FROM ov)

question: What percentage of completed orders include at least one discounted item?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.discount_pct>0 THEN o.order_id END)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed'

question: Which month had the most customer signups?
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(signup_date,'%Y-%m') FROM customers GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(signup_date,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many active customers do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

question: What was the revenue in H2 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31'

question: What is the gross margin percentage overall (gross profit divided by net revenue)?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100*SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100) - oi.quantity*p.cost)/SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed'

question: Which 3 products were returned in the highest quantities?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='returned' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 3
